name: Mujou no Erasmus - The Erasmus two-faced stories
original_name: 霧上のエラスムス - The Erasmus two-faced stories
source:
First story:

One day, Mell receives a mysterious e-mail from someone who signs themselves as the “Witch of Fog”. The Witch has organized a class reunion for him and his former roommates who all attended Erasmus in Strasbourg together.

--

Second story:

[spoiler]Ten years before the first story, Michel receives an e-mail from Neige, his e-mail penpal he has met on an online suicide community. She wonders whether he really exists in this world and asks him to meet in Prague the day after tomorrow.[/spoiler]
translation:
第一个故事：

有一天，梅尔收到一封神秘电子邮件，发件人自称“雾之女巫”。女巫为他和他以前的室友组织了一次同学聚会，他们都一起参加了斯特拉斯堡的伊拉斯谟课程。

--

第二个故事：[spoiler]第一个故事发生的十年前，米歇尔收到了一封来自奈吉的电子邮件，奈吉是他在一个在线自杀社区上认识的电子邮件笔友。她想知道他是否真的存在于这个世界上，并约他后天在布拉格见面。[/spoiler]
